actions.action: Route intake without opening electrical equipment
actions.mechanism: Separate observable needs from uncertain diagnosis before assigning scarce bench and specialist attention.
actions.implementation: General volunteers record symptoms, item type, and owner availability externally. Mark electrical opening as specialist-only; label potentially short jobs as provisional.
actions.check: Audit intake cards: every electrical opening is assigned to the specialist, and duration guesses are not presented as commitments.
actions.risk: External screening can misclassify jobs; revise routing after diagnosis.

actions.action: Alternate bench starts and review uncertain work
actions.mechanism: Protected turns for potentially short jobs prevent uncertain repairs from taking every newly available bench slot.
actions.implementation: Alternate starts between provisional-short and other ready jobs. Review diagnosis every 15 minutes; safely park stalled items with a recorded location.
actions.check: While both queues have eligible jobs, neither receives consecutive starts. Log review overruns and safety reasons preventing bench release.
actions.risk: Safe stopping may delay release; review intervals are not completion promises.

actions.action: Move parts-blocked items out of active work
actions.mechanism: Explicit blocking conditions prevent unavailable parts from silently consuming bench time or appearing as ongoing repairs.
actions.implementation: Use READY, ACTIVE, and WAITING-PARTS labels. Once safe to move, park blocked items in identified storage; record needed part and follow-up owner.
actions.check: At shift end, every WAITING-PARTS item has a location, responsible person, and re-entry condition; none occupies a bench without documented justification.
actions.risk: Storage is finite; stop accepting unattended items when identified spaces fill.

actions.action: Bind receipts, movement records, and handoff acceptance
actions.mechanism: A persistent item identity preserves custody while explicit acceptance transfers responsibility rather than merely leaving notes.
actions.implementation: Give each item and owner receipt matching IDs. Record every location change, current custodian, and next action; require incoming-shift acceptance.
actions.check: Reconcile every retained item against its receipt record and location; verify each handoff identifies an accepting custodian and actionable next step.
actions.risk: Missing acceptance leaves responsibility unresolved; escalate to the outgoing shift lead.
